summary: Iteration 4 frontend-only e2e test of v4 (Three.js 3D intro loader + redesigned 'Stabl stangen' Matter.js stacking mini-game). All four new/changed user-stories PASS. Intro loader renders a full-screen black overlay with WebGL canvas + 'TRÆNINGSMESTER' wordmark + progress bar + 'Tryk for at springe over' hint; auto-dismisses on its own (verified within 6s), honours prefers-reduced-motion (skips quickly), and is click/Space skippable (DOM detaches; body scroll lock releases). The new arcade game works end-to-end: overlay → Start spil → plate swings → 'Slip skive' lands plates → score increments (verified 0 → 4 → 16 → 30 across drops) → combo & best HUD update → localStorage key 'tm-stack-best' persists across reload (value 30 confirmed) → spacebar drops a plate while playing → no NaN in score/combo/best → no JS console errors. Sticky 'Tre faser' pillars verified on desktop 1440x900 with reduced_motion=no-preference: pillars-pin computed position='sticky', pinTop=0 during scroll (true pinning), activeNav cycles 0→1→2 and shotsOpacity cross-fades (1,0,0)→(0.66,0.34,0)→(0,0.04,0.93), zero horizontal overflow. Waitlist regression: invalid email shows Danish error 'Skriv en gyldig emailadresse.', missing consent shows 'Accepter kontakt om Træningsmester for at skrive dig op.' (Supabase happy-path was verified end-to-end in iteration_3 with 201 OK; not re-posted in this run to avoid duplicate writes and because the cookie banner overlay made the consent checkbox flaky for Playwright in this session — non-app bug). General regression: header nav present, mobile menu toggle works at 390px, FAQ accordion toggles aria-expanded, cookie-accept dismisses banner, footer-terms opens [data-testid=legal-panel] and legal-close closes it. Zero non-CSP console errors during entire run.

Auto-dismissed (detached from DOM) within ~4s of page load. After dismiss body.overflow='clip visible' (scrollable). Hero waitlist form visible after intro.

action_items: NONE BLOCKING. The intro loader, mini-game, sticky pillars, waitlist regression, and general UI all pass.
Optional (carried from prior iterations): main.tsx is ~1578 lines — code-review guideline recommends splitting >700-line files into modules. Not user-facing.

Optional: scrollToPillar(i) targets wrap.offsetTop + total * ((i + 0.5) / pillars.length). For i=2 this overshoots the visible activation range slightly; consider using ((i + 0.5) / pillars.length) * (1 - viewportFactor) or scrolling to a frame where the activeNav class will resolve to the requested index. Minor — visually the click still navigates into the section.
critical_code_review_comments: IntroLoader.tsx is well-bounded: 6s safety timeout, raf cancel on unmount, geometry/material/texture disposal, body.scrollTo(0,0) and overflow lock cleanup all correct. Honours prefers-reduced-motion with a fast 650ms exit. Good.
PlatePlayground.tsx — active plate created as dynamic and pinned via beforeUpdate is the correct fix for the prior 0-score/NaN bug; verified at runtime scoring works deterministically.

Cookie banner's OK button sits over the hero waitlist consent checkbox at default scroll on 1440x900 (z-index/position), making Playwright Page.check on [data-testid=hero-waitlist-consent] fail with 'Clicking the checkbox did not change its state' until the banner is dismissed. Real users tab/scroll past it, so not a functional blocker; consider giving the cookie banner a lower z-index than the hero form OR rendering it bottom-anchored so it never overlaps interactive form controls.

When CSS prefers-reduced-motion is active, .pillars-pin is intentionally unpinned (position:static) — confirmed by source. Testing teams should toggle emulate_media reduced_motion='no-preference' to verify the sticky pin.

Carried from iter_3: form.noValidate is set at runtime by tests so the app-level Danish validation message surfaces. Real users typing 'abc' will see the browser's native English popup first. Consider adding noValidate to the <form> elements in source so Danish copy shows consistently.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 5 user-listed groups + new intro + new game pass; 1 happy-path re-verified from iter_3)

seed_data_creation: No new Supabase rows created this iteration (avoided duplicate writes). One row was created in iteration_3 from 'qa+tm-v3-test-1782050293@example.com'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: v4 adds (a) Three.js 3D intro loader (~3.45s) at first paint with reduced-motion + click/Space skip + auto-dismiss safety, and (b) a redesigned Matter.js stacking arcade 'Stabl stangen' replacing the previous plate-drop showcase. Both work. To test the FULL intro animation, use page.emulate_media(reduced_motion='no-preference') before goto — otherwise CSS reduced-motion fast-path applies. To check the sticky pillars at desktop, you ALSO must use reduced_motion='no-preference' because the CSS unpins them under reduce. For waitlist happy-path, dismiss the cookie banner first (page.click('[data-testid=cookie-accept]')) before page.check on hero-waitlist-consent — otherwise the banner z-index intercepts the checkbox click. Mini-game best score persists via localStorage key 'tm-stack-best'.
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs to RCA. Two harness gotchas to remember: (1) prefers-reduced-motion forces both the intro and the .pillars-pin to a fast/static path — set no-preference to exercise the full animations; (2) the cookie banner overlay can intercept clicks on the hero waitlist consent checkbox in default scroll position — dismiss the banner first in test setup.
